optimized_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
        SELECT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, date_dim.d_date
        FROM customer
        JOIN store_sales
          ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
        JOIN date_dim
          ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
         AND date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
        GROUP BY customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, date_dim.d_date
    ) AS store_channel
    JOIN (
        SELECT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, date_dim.d_date
        FROM customer
        JOIN catalog_sales
          ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
        JOIN date_dim
          ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
         AND date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
        GROUP BY customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, date_dim.d_date
    ) AS catalog_channel
      ON store_channel.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM catalog_channel.c_last_name
     AND store_channel.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM catalog_channel.c_first_name
     AND store_channel.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM catalog_channel.d_date
    JOIN (
        SELECT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, date_dim.d_date
        FROM customer
        JOIN web_sales
          ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
        JOIN date_dim
          ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
         AND date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
        GROUP BY customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, date_dim.d_date
    ) AS web_channel
      ON store_channel.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM web_channel.c_last_name
     AND store_channel.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM web_channel.c_first_name
     AND store_channel.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM web_channel.d_date
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
